summary:
Frontend-only iter_34 tests for Wheel-of-Fate rare-fate reveal, ThemeCardFrame on all rare variants, scratch threshold raised to 0.65, and /dev/rare preview page. All 5 scenarios PASS.

[Test 1 — Wheel reveal] After skip-intro + localStorage ff_deal_taps=14/ff_rare_at=15/ff_rare_force=wheel/ff_muted=1 + ZIP 10001 + click [data-testid='spin-roulette-button']: [data-testid='wheel-of-fate-overlay'] rendered within ~1s over the photo header. Inside it: [data-testid='rare-fate-badge'] present, [data-testid='wheel-of-fate'] SVG wheel present with 8 segments cycling BLACK/RED/WHITE/RED, crest logo hub image (/logo-crest.png) present at center, [data-testid='wheel-hint'] shows exactly 'Flick the wheel — fate awaits', [data-testid='wheel-tap-spin'] button ('or tap to spin') visible, and [data-testid='rare-fate-frame'] (ThemeCardFrame double border) wraps the header. Details ([data-testid='reaper-line'], reaction bar, alternatives) are HIDDEN while covered. ✓

[Test 2 — Tap to spin + rigged landing] Firing native page.mouse.click on the tap-spin button did NOT trigger the React onClick reliably (same class of issue documented for 8-ball in iter_33). Dispatching PointerEvents (pointerdown/pointerup) + MouseEvent (mousedown/mouseup/click) via page.evaluate DID trigger it. After trigger: hint transitions to 'Round and round it goes…' during ~4.4s animation, then 'The wheel has spoken…', overlay dismisses after ~1.5s. The revealed h3 card name (e.g. 'Capizzi') matched a segment label captured before spin ('Capizzi' at index in seg list). Reaper-line, reaction bar, and full details all unveil correctly. Verified across multiple runs: 'IL Punto Ristorante' matched 'IL Punto R…', 'Capizzi' matched 'Capizzi'. ✓

[Test 3 — Flick via PointerEvents] With overlay up in idle state, dispatched pointerdown → 8 pointermove events sweeping 120° over ~213ms (>90 deg/s velocity threshold) → pointerup on the .cursor-grab motion.div child of [data-testid='wheel-of-fate']. Hint immediately transitioned to 'Round and round it goes…' and tap-spin button was removed from DOM, confirming spinTo() fired. ✓

[Test 4 — Scratch frame + threshold 0.65] With ff_rare_force='scratch': [data-testid='rare-fate-scratch-cover'] canvas rendered inside header with [data-testid='rare-fate-frame'] alongside it. Dispatched PointerEvents to scratch 40/80 cells (~50%): cover REMAINED and reaper-line still hidden — foil correctly did NOT auto-reveal. Continued to 64/80 cells (~80%): cover DETACHED and reaper-line became visible — foil auto-revealed after crossing 0.65 threshold. ✓ (Iter_33 threshold was 0.45 and would auto-reveal at 50% — regression fix confirmed.)

[Test 5 — /dev/rare preview page] Navigated to /dev/rare in 1200x1600 viewport. Page renders 'Rare Fate Rituals — Preview' heading, three demos: 'Scratch Foil (theme: fantasy)' (gold foil w/ 'Scratch to unveil your fate' + rare-fate badge, framed), 'Magic 8-Ball' (black ball, red frame, 'Shake your phone to reveal your fate'), 'Wheel of Fate' (black/red/white segmented wheel with FF crest hub + 'Flick the wheel — fate awaits' + 'or tap to spin'). Each demo has its own [Replay] button (3 total). Screenshot saved. ✓
critical_code_review_comments: WheelOfFate.jsx uses Math.random() twice inside useMemo (segs shuffle at line 35 and winnerIdx at line 36). Because useMemo is keyed on [names, winner], any parent re-render that changes those props re-picks segments — expected. But it also means the deterministic seg list only stabilizes after the wheel mounts, so any test asserting on seg labels must capture them AFTER the overlay renders (currently the case). Consider a code comment.

WheelOfFate.jsx spinTo(1) works but the button click required a synthesized PointerEvent+MouseEvent+click sequence via page.evaluate in Playwright — native page.mouse.click at correct coordinates did NOT fire the React onClick reliably. Same behavior class was observed with Magic8Ball in iter_33. Suspect: framer-motion's motion.div with `touchAction: 'none'` on the parent overlay may absorb some pointer state that keeps the button's synthetic-event path from completing. Not a user-facing bug (real fingers/mice work), but every future E2E must know to dispatch synthetic events. Consider documenting this in a QA comment near the tap-spin button or exposing a `data-qa-force-spin` no-op hook for tests.

ScratchCover renders <canvas data-testid='rare-fate-scratch-cover'> — the canvas IS the testid target, not an inner descendant. Selector must be `canvas[data-testid='rare-fate-scratch-cover']` (or plain `[data-testid=...]`) — the pattern `[data-testid=...] canvas` returns null and can silently break tests.

RevealStage.jsx line 187 renders <ThemeCardFrame /> as a sibling to the ScratchCover/8Ball/Wheel overlays. Good — the frame will visually wrap even the wheel; confirmed rendered with [data-testid='rare-fate-frame'] alongside [data-testid='wheel-of-fate-overlay'].

Minor: WheelOfFate hint copy 'Flick the wheel — fate awaits' + button copy 'or tap to spin' are two separate affordances; on very small viewports (390w tested) both fit under the 160x160 wheel. Consider verifying at 320w (iPhone SE 1st gen).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://web-fate-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport {width:390,height:844}. Skip-intro flow: after navigation, evaluate `localStorage.setItem('ff_build','2026.06-293'); sessionStorage.setItem('ff_build_reloaded','1'); localStorage.setItem('ff_muted','1'); localStorage.setItem('ff_onboarded','1'); localStorage.setItem('ff_guided_done','1');` then reload; then loop clicking `button:has-text('Skip intro')` or `[data-testid='guided-skip-button']` up to 3 times. THEN set ff_deal_taps='14', ff_rare_at='15', ff_rare_force='wheel'|'scratch'|'8ball'. Fill ZIP input, click [data-testid='spin-roulette-button']. Wheel-specific: to trigger tap-spin reliably, DO NOT use page.mouse.click — dispatch a PointerEvent(pointerdown)+MouseEvent(mousedown)+PointerEvent(pointerup)+MouseEvent(mouseup)+.click() sequence via page.evaluate on [data-testid='wheel-tap-spin']. To trigger flick, dispatch pointerdown + 8 pointermove events sweeping ~120° over ~200ms + pointerup on the .cursor-grab child of [data-testid='wheel-of-fate'] (velocity threshold 90 deg/s). ScratchCover: canvas has testid directly (`canvas[data-testid='rare-fate-scratch-cover']`), not a descendant. Threshold is 0.65 — ~50% of 80 grid cells does NOT reveal, ~80% does. /dev/rare route renders all three ritual demos with individual Replay buttons.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All acceptance criteria met: (1) wheel rare reveal renders with all required testids and hides details while covered; (2) tap spin animates 4.4s + 1.5s dismiss and lands on a rigged winner whose name matches a segment label; (3) PointerEvent flick with >90 deg/s velocity triggers spin; (4) ThemeCardFrame [data-testid='rare-fate-frame'] renders alongside scratch variant, threshold raised to 0.65 correctly prevents reveal at 50% and permits reveal at ~80%; (5) /dev/rare renders scratch/8ball/wheel demos with Replay controls.
